charge_port.notes: Cars.com/Wikipedia: DC fast charging (CCS) $995 option on SE, standard on SEL Premium and Limited Edition. SE cars without the option have J1772 only (counts unknown). Canada not separately sourced.

supercharger_access.notes: VW Canada: the NACS DC adapter is officially for ID.4 and ID. Buzz and is not compatible with the e-Golf; Electrek (2025-11-12) lists only ID.4 and ID. Buzz. Applied to US and Canada.

wheels.notes: e-Golf SE 2019: 16x6.5 read on this Cars.com page (US market). The SEL Premium page for that year also shows 16-inch. Only one trim page was read for this year; other trims not opened.
